# infrawrench_commitment_report (Resource)

A saved commitment report: coverage, utilization, effective savings rate, net savings against on-demand, the on-demand remainder and commitment cost (used and unused) over a window, for reserved instances, savings plans and committed-use discounts. Every metric is computed on the amortized basis; the docs page defines each.

Reports file into the same folder tree as cost reports (`infrawrench_cost_report_folder`) and are shared with `infrawrench_object_sharing` using `object_type = "commitment_report"`.

Set either `date_preset`, or both `date_from` and `date_to`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_cost_report_folder" "finops" {
  name = "FinOps"
}

# Savings plan and reservation performance per week, split by commitment type.
resource "infrawrench_commitment_report" "weekly_by_type" {
  name        = "Commitment performance by type"
  folder_id   = infrawrench_cost_report_folder.finops.id
  date_preset = "90d"
  granularity = "weekly"
  group_by    = "commitment_type"
  metric      = "utilization"
}

# AWS coverage of EC2 per month over a fixed year, one line per account.
resource "infrawrench_commitment_report" "ec2_coverage" {
  name        = "EC2 coverage by account"
  folder_id   = infrawrench_cost_report_folder.finops.id
  date_from   = "2025-10-01"
  date_to     = "2026-09-30"
  granularity = "monthly"
  group_by    = "account"
  metric      = "coverage"
  providers   = ["aws"]
  services    = ["Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1–120 characters.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) Connected account ids, e.g. `infrawrench_account.prod.id`. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `commitment_ids` (Set of String) Provider-native commitment ids (reservation, savings plan or commitment ids). Narrows the commitment side only, like `commitment_types`. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `commitment_types` (Set of String) Commitment kinds, any of `reservation`, `savings_plan`, `committed_use`. Narrows the commitment side only: uncovered usage stays in as the rest of the coverage denominator. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `date_from` (String) First day of a fixed window, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Requires `date_to`.
- `date_preset` (String) A window relative to each run, one of `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `mtd`, `last_month`, `qtd`, `ytd`, `6m`, `12m`. Conflicts with `date_from` / `date_to`.
- `date_to` (String) Last day of a fixed window, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Requires `date_from`.
- `description` (String) Free text shown under the title. At most 2000 characters.
- `folder_id` (String) Id of the `infrawrench_cost_report_folder` the report is filed in. Clearing it moves the report to the top level.
- `granularity` (String) Bucket size, one of `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`. Defaults to `weekly`. There is no hourly: spend is stored one row per day. Weeks start on Monday. A daily report covers at most 366 days, any report at most 1096.
- `group_by` (String) Split, one of `none`, `provider`, `commitment_type`, `commitment`, `service`, `account`, `region`. Defaults to `none`. `commitment_type` and `commitment` split the commitment side by holding and put uncovered usage in its own group.
- `metric` (String) The metric the chart draws, one of `coverage`, `eligibleCoverage`, `utilization`, `effectiveSavingsRate`, `netSavings`, `onDemandRemainder`, `commitmentCost`, `usedCommitmentCost`, `unusedCommitmentCost`. Defaults to `coverage`. The table always shows every metric.
- `providers` (Set of String) Plugin ids to include, e.g. `aws`, `azure`, `gcp`. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `regions` (Set of String) Region codes exactly as cost data reports them. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `services` (Set of String) Service names exactly as cost data reports them. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned report id. Use it with `terraform import`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the object in the app, and in the
# --json output of the Infrawrench CLI (`infrawrench commitments reports --json`).
terraform import infrawrench_commitment_report.example 7b8c9d0e-1f2a-3b4c-5d6e-7f8a9b0c1d2e
```
